auxiliaryType.description: Auxiliary-view creation mode. Normal creates a normal auxiliary view from an edge that is linear in projection, InLine creates an in-line auxiliary view from either a projected-linear edge or a linear axis reference, and Axis creates an auxiliary view along the tilted axis of a hole entity.

referenceEntity.description: Associative reference used to create the auxiliary view. Normal requires an edge that is linear in the parent-view projection. InLine accepts either a projected-linear edge or a linear centerline/axis reference. Axis accepts a supported hole entity such as a circle, arc, ellipse, circular centerline, center mark, or circular spline.

viewingLinePosition.description: Position of the auxiliary viewing line midpoint, corresponding to its center grip.

viewingLineLength.description: Length of the auxiliary viewing line. Applies only to the Line style format.

flipDirection.description: Reverses the viewing direction by 180 degrees.

showViewReferenceIndicator.description: Shows or hides the auxiliary view-reference indicator created in the parent view. When omitted, the value is inherited from the visibility setting of the Standard auxiliary-line style.

viewingLineLabelStartPosition.description: Position of the viewing line start label in ANSI template

viewingLineLabelEndPosition.description: Position of the viewing line end label in ANSI template

viewIndicatorLabelPosition.description: Position of the view indicator label in ISO template
